notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR20: when the PERFORM control mechanism transfers to procedure-name-1, DEBUG-LINE the PERFORM, DEBUG-NAME procedure-name-1, 'DEBUG-CONTENTS contains 'PERFORM LOOP''. ControlFlowEmitter.EmitOutOfLinePerform sets the PerformLoop cause with the PERFORM's line on every transfer of every loop form. Probes: witness matches; d7 (2 TIMES: two triggers line 21; zero and negative TIMES and UNTIL already true: none; VARYING I 1..2: two; PA THRU PB: PA PERFORM LOOP, PB FALL THROUGH); d1 (PERFORM line 23); 2002/2023 COBOL0902. PERFORM of a subject section's first paragraph also runs it (d8): the GR3 defect.

next.reason: 1985: "DEBUG-CONTENTS contains 'PERFORM LOOP'."; 2023: "No candidate covers USE FOR DEBUGGING or DEBUG-LINE/DEBUG-NAME/DEBUG-CONTENTS; the Debug module is absent from 2023.". No clause holds the Debug feature. The USE and PERFORM candidates cover transfer of control only and set no debugging special registers, so the requirement is dropped.
